parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  content, 
  category, 
  source_url, 
  title,
  1 - (embedding <=> '{{ $json.embedding }}'::vector) as similarity
FROM legal_knowledge
WHERE 1 - (embedding <=> '{{ $json.embedding }}'::vector) > 0.7
ORDER BY embedding <=> '{{ $json.embedding }}'::vector
LIMIT 10;
